in_sanskrit.name: Budu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessed, Fortunate
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Budu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Budu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'budhah', meaning wise or intelligent. It is also associated with the Buddha, representing the enlightened one. In Hindu mythology, Budu is a name for the deity Ganesha, the elephant-headed god who is the remover of obstacles.
